proof:
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000 in
  intro N inst c
  change M6.Euclid.preprocessBitCost N (M7.Supports.polynomial c.1)
    (M7.Supports.polynomial c.2) (M6.Cyclic.modulus N) ≤ 180 * (N + 1)^3
  have ha : (M7.Supports.polynomial c.1).natDegree < N := by
    apply M7.Supports.degree_lt
  have hb : (M7.Supports.polynomial c.2).natDegree < N := by
    apply M7.Supports.degree_lt
  have ha' : (M7.Supports.polynomial c.1).natDegree ≤ N := Nat.le_of_lt ha
  have hb' : (M7.Supports.polynomial c.2).natDegree ≤ N := Nat.le_of_lt hb
  have hm : (M6.Cyclic.modulus N).natDegree ≤ N := by
    unfold M6.Cyclic.modulus
    first
    | simp
    | exact (Polynomial.natDegree_sub_le _ _).trans (by simp)
    | exact (Polynomial.natDegree_add_le _ _).trans (by simp)
  have h := M6.Euclid.preprocess_correct_cost N
    (M7.Supports.polynomial c.1) (M7.Supports.polynomial c.2)
    (M6.Cyclic.modulus N)
  repeat' specialize h (by first | assumption | omega)
  aesop
